verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's flags (its closest analog to 'automations') have change history, approvals, scheduled changes, and rollback via targeting/rollout controls, which cover versioning and review workflows for flag changes. However, this is framed around feature flags/rollouts, not AI agent automations specifically, and there's no evidence of a dedicated automation-versioning UI, diff/review workflow for AI-agent-driven changes, or audit trail tied to AI-native usage. missing for 10: explicit versioning/rollback UI for AI-generated automations, review/approval workflow tied to AI agent changes, independent confirmation that change history supports full rollback of complex rule sets.
